message.isekai_mahou.glyphs_classes_a.re: %s: this spell fires on its own when the condition happens (the key doesn't cast it).
message.isekai_mahou.glyphs_classes_a.in: Potion Infusion: no potion in your off hand or hotbar.
message.isekai_mahou.glyphs_classes_a.ch: Chorus of the Dead: no mana for more voices.
message.isekai_mahou.glyphs_classes_a.le: New class glyph: %s (%s). Other classes can only learn it from your Lesson.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mage_metamagic.desc: Mage AUGMENT (Circle 4). Magic about magic: REPEATS the augments placed BEFORE it on this glyph — every Amplify, Expand, Extend, Accelerate, Split, Pierce, Ricochet, Chain and Charge counts again (up to +2 each; Repeat up to +1). Right after the form/effect with no augments before it, it does nothing. Cost: the spell spends +40%% mana (or health, with Overload) and takes +0.3 s to cast. Doesn't stack. Learned: the Mage's 3rd Thesis (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Mage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mage_trigger_weave.de: Mage TRIGGER (Circle 4). Cast 3 spells of DIFFERENT elements (Arcane doesn't count) within 8 s: this slot's spell fires ON ITS OWN, aimed at the nearest enemy. The action bar shows the weave (1/3, 2/3). The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 5 s. Learned: the Mage's 4th Thesis (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Mage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.witch_potion_infusion: Witch AUGMENT (Circle 3). When cast, the spell CONSUMES the potion in your off hand (or the first one in your hotbar): good effects go to you and allies within 5 blocks (60%% duration); bad effects go on every enemy the spell hurts (50%% duration, up to 8 targets). A lingering potion also leaves a cloud on the first target. Without a potion it does nothing. Learned: the Witch's 3rd Revelation (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Witch.
Witch TRIGGER (Circle 4). When you finish DRINKING a potion (or a cauldron brew), this slot's spell fires on its own, aimed at the nearest enemy. The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 1 s. Learned: the Witch's 4th Revelation (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Witch.
glyph.isekai_mahou.warlock_blood_pact.de: Warlock AUGMENT (Circle 3). The Patron collects in BLOOD: the spell is paid with HEALTH instead of mana (like Overload, with the same +40%% power) and costs +25%% extra blood. The less health you have, the stronger it gets: +1%% power for every 1%% of missing health (up to +50%%). Every enemy the spell kills refunds 30%% of the blood paid (up to 3). Never leaves you below half a heart. Learned: the Warlock's 5th pact (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Warlock.
glyph.isekai_mahou.warlock_trigger_curse: Warlock TRIGGER (Circle 4). When another creature puts a NEGATIVE effect on you (poison, wither, slowness, weakness, blindness, burning, curses...), the Patron strikes back: this slot's spell fires on its own aimed at WHOEVER cursed you (or the nearest enemy). Silence and Exhaustion don't count. The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 4 s. Learned: the Warlock's 7th pact (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Warlock.
glyph.isekai_mahou.druid_overgrowth.desc: Druid AUGMENT (Circle 3). Wherever the spell hurts, the earth SPROUTS: a thicket of vines (radius 2.5 — Expand on the form +; 6 s — Extend +) that ROOTS each enemy the first time it enters (2 s; bosses are only slowed), slows everyone inside and stabs with thorns; allies inside regain health. Up to 3 thickets of yours at once. Learned: the Heart Tree's 5th stage (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Druid.
Druid TRIGGER (Circle 4). Stand STILL for 3 s on natural ground (dirt, grass, moss, mud, sand or leaves): you take root and this slot's spell fires on its own — aimed at the nearest enemy — and repeats every 6 s while you stay rooted. It only fires with an enemy nearby or while you are hurt. The slot key doesn't cast it. Learned: the Heart Tree's 7th stage (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Druid.
glyph.isekai_mahou.necro_dead_chorus.des: Necromancer AUGMENT (Circle 4). Your dead cast with you: up to 3 of your minions within 16 blocks (servants, summons, pets) release a COPY of the spell from where they stand, aimed at their target (or where you look), at 40%% power. Each copy costs 15%% of the spell's mana. Doesn't work on forms tied to you (Self, Aura, Stance, Touch...), Domains or ultimates. Learned: the 4th Ossuary Rite (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Necromancer.
glyph.isekai_mahou.necro_trigger_minion_: Necromancer TRIGGER (Circle 4). When one of your minions (servant, summon or pet) dies within 48 blocks, its soul returns to you and this slot's spell fires on its own, aimed at WHOEVER killed it (or the enemy nearest the body). The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 1 s. Learned: the 5th Ossuary Rite (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Necromancer.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_forged_edge.des: Smith AUGMENT (Circle 3). The spell carries the EDGE of the weapon you hold: each hit adds 60%% of the weapon's damage (×1.5). Blades (swords, axes) make the target BLEED; heavy weapons (hammers, maces...) KNOCK BACK. Cost: 1 weapon durability per hit. Empty-handed it does nothing. Learned: Forge Trials, rank II (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Smith.
Smith TRIGGER (Circle 4). Like a hammer on the anvil: the 3rd melee hit IN A ROW on the same target (up to 3 s between hits) makes this slot's spell fire on its own at it. Forging or reshaping a weapon at the Forge also fires it. The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 1.5 s. Learned: Forge Trials, rank III (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Smith.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_from_behind.des: Rogue AUGMENT (Circle 3). If the target is NOT looking at you (you are behind it, or invisible), the spell deals ×1.6 damage (bosses ×1.3) and it bleeds for 2 s. If it is facing you, ×0.85. Learned: Ledger, rank II (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Rogue.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rogue_trigger_steal.d: Rogue TRIGGER (Circle 4). When you STEAL something — an item, mana, a blessing or a spell —, this slot's spell fires on its own, aimed at the nearest victim. The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 3 s. Learned: Ledger, rank III (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Rogue.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_challenge.desc: Knight AUGMENT (Circle 3). Every enemy hurt by the spell is PROVOKED for 6 s (bosses 3 s): it can only target you and deals −30%% damage to anyone else. You gain Absorption for 6 s — stronger the more enemies you provoke at once (up to level III). Learned: 2nd Oath (or Circle 6). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Knight.
Knight TRIGGER (Circle 4). When an ally within 8 blocks (party player, pet, summon) is attacked, you step in: the blow on them drops 25%% and this slot's spell fires on its own, aimed at the attacker. The slot key doesn't cast it. Interval: 3 s. Learned: 3rd Oath (or Circle 7). Other classes: only from a Lesson by a Knight.
